purpose: A calendar for organising in the District: tenant meetings, know-your-rights trainings, mutual aid, teach-ins, rallies, and the culture that carries all of it.
onair_pitch: List an event here and you may hear it on 89.3 FM. Our daily Social Justice Calendar roundup reaches listeners across the DMV.
broadcast_notice: Listings may be featured in our daily Social Justice Calendar roundup on air. WPFW broadcasts across the DMV.
list_pitch: Send me the weekly roundup of social justice events in the District.
